How ironic. Humanity has progressed so far that today, thanks to the internet, even someone like you can reach millions of people and potentially make a living simply by sharing opinions. Citing IMF reports doesn't make a ranking scientific when you cherry-pick one metric per country and ignore everything else.

​And placing Tuvalu and Kiribati in Yellow ("in trouble, but with a believable way out") because of migration treaties isn't a "way out"—that’s literally abandoning the country as it sinks. 

Fun video, zero analytical consistency. 

In essence a vaste of time.
